title: Insertion recurrence for intersection energy
statement: Let $S$ be a finite set, let $i$ be an element not in $S$, and let $g$ be a real-valued function on the finite subsets of the ambient set. For finite $T$, define $E_T(g)=\\sum_{A,B\\subseteq T}(-1)^{|T|-|A|}(-1)^{|T|-|B|}g(A\\cap B)$. Then $E_{S\\cup\\{i\\}}(g)=E_S(T\\mapsto g(T\\cup\\{i\\}))-E_S(g)$.
hypotheses_covered: $g$ is a real-valued function on finite subsets of the ambient set
replaced: For a finite set $S$, an element $i\notin S$, and a real function $g$ on finite subsets, put $E_T(g)=\sum_{A,B\subseteq T}(-1)^{|T|-|A|}(-1)^{|T|-|B|}g(A\cap B)$. Then $E_{S\cup\{i\}}(g)=E_S(T\mapsto g(T\cup\{i\}))-E_S(g)$.
